title: Transfer of Property Act, 1882 — Section 62 (Right of usufructuary mortgagor to recover possession)

content.overview: Where the mortgagee is in possession as a usufructuary mortgagee, the mortgagor may recover possession when the money is paid or the mortgage-money is discharged from rents and profits.
content.glance: Where the mortgagee is in possession as a usufructuary mortgagee, the mortgagor may recover possession when the money is paid or the mortgage-money is discharged from rents and profits.
